name: @pipeworx/mcp-mitre-cwe

tools.name: weakness
tools.description: "What is CWE-[N]" / "look up CWE [name]" / "details on [weakness]" / "explain XSS / SQL injection / buffer overflow" / "what kind of security flaw is [X]" — fetch a single MITRE CWE (Common Weakness Enumeration) record with description, examples, mitigations, related attacks, references. Use for security analysis, vulnerability triage, threat-modeling, secure-coding training. Example IDs: 79 (XSS), 89 (SQL injection), 787 (out-of-bounds write).

view.description: Optional view id to retrieve view-specific info.

tools.name: category
tools.description: "What CWEs fall under [category]" / "list weaknesses in the [X] family" / "memory safety weaknesses" / "input validation weaknesses" — fetch a CWE category record (a thematic grouping of related CWEs like "Memory Safety", "Input Validation", "Cryptographic Issues"). Returns the category description plus member CWE IDs.

tools.name: view
tools.description: "Top 25 most dangerous software weaknesses" / "OWASP Top 10 CWE mapping" / "CWE view [N]" — fetch a curated CWE view (a published, opinionated selection of weaknesses). View 1003 = simplified mapping (NVD uses this), view 1387 = Top 25, view 1344 = OWASP Top 10. Returns the view's metadata plus the included CWE IDs.

tools.name: children
tools.description: "CWEs derived from / under [N]" / "child weaknesses of [CWE]" / "more specific variants of [X]" — list immediate children of a CWE in the relationship tree. CWE is hierarchical; e.g. children of CWE-119 (memory bounds) include CWE-787 (out-of-bounds write) and CWE-125 (out-of-bounds read).

tools.name: parents
tools.description: "What's the parent CWE of [N]" / "broader weakness category for [X]" / "where does [CWE] sit in the taxonomy" — list immediate parents of a CWE in the relationship tree. Use to walk up to a more general weakness class.

tools.name: descendants
tools.description: "All weaknesses derived from [CWE]" / "full subtree below [N]" / "every variant of [X]" — full transitive descendants (children, grandchildren, …) of a CWE. Use for exhaustive coverage analysis — e.g. "every memory-safety weakness" via descendants of CWE-664/119.

tools.name: relationship
tools.description: "How is [CWE-A] related to [CWE-B]" / "relationship between two weaknesses" — fetch the directional relationship (parent/child/peer/precedes/can-precede) between two specific CWE IDs. Specialty tool; most queries are better served by children / parents / descendants.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-mitre-cwe forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the mitre-cwe pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
